# package arxml

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/arxml"
```

Package arxml reads the CAN part of AUTOSAR 4.x system descriptions (ARXML) into the format-independent model of package candb.

Supported: CAN-CLUSTER physical channels with CAN-FRAME-TRIGGERINGs (IDENTIFIER, CAN-ADDRESSING-MODE, CAN FD frame behaviour, frame ports for senders and receivers), CAN-FRAMEs with PDU-TO-FRAME-MAPPINGs at byte offsets, I-SIGNAL-I-PDUs with I-SIGNAL-TO-I-PDU-MAPPINGs (PACKING-BYTE-ORDER, START-POSITION), MULTIPLEXED-I-PDUs, I-SIGNALs (LENGTH, INIT-VALUE, base type encoding for signed and IEEE 754 signals), SYSTEM-SIGNALs and COMPU-METHODs of the categories IDENTICAL, LINEAR, TEXTTABLE and SCALE\_LINEAR\_AND\_TEXTTABLE, UNITs, and physical limits from DATA-CONSTRs.

START-POSITION is taken as the DBC start bit in both byte orders, as cantools and canmatrix read it (checked in the interop suite).

A MULTIPLEXED-I-PDU becomes multiplexed signals, as cantools reads it: a multiplexer switch "\<frame>\_selector\<n>" at the SELECTOR-FIELD (n counts the frame's multiplexed PDUs from 1), the signals of each DYNAMIC-PART-ALTERNATIVE multiplexed by its SELECTOR-FIELD-CODE, and the signals of the STATIC-PARTs always present. An alternative's own mapping of the selector field is dropped (its value descriptions go to the switch); the INITIAL-DYNAMIC-PART gives the switch's initial value. A signal mapped identically in several alternatives is present for each of their codes. SEGMENT-POSITIONS are not applied: an alternative's signals keep their positions, which lie in the dynamic segment.

Everything else (AUTOSAR 3.x, nested multiplexing, container and secured PDUs, signal groups, end-to-end protection, other bus types) is reported as a diagnostic and skipped: no ARXML compatibility beyond these elements is claimed.

Bounds on untrusted input: elements nested deeper than 256 levels end Parse with an error, as does a database of more than 262144 (2^18) signals or 2097152 (2^21) value descriptions (each triggering of a frame counts its signals again). A PDU mapped more than once into one frame is an error and is read once. TEXTTABLE scales are expanded only for finite limits of at most 2^53 in magnitude and at most 256 values. At most 1000 diagnostics are returned; a final diagnostic, as severe as the worst one left out, counts the rest.

## Functions

### func Parse

```go
func Parse(r io.Reader) (*candb.Database, []candb.Diagnostic, error)
```

Parse reads ARXML. It returns the database, every diagnostic and, when any is an error, a \*[ParseError](#type-parseerror).

### func ParseFile

```go
func ParseFile(path string) (*candb.Database, []candb.Diagnostic, error)
```

ParseFile reads an ARXML file. See [Parse](#func-parse).
